description: This file defines internal utilities and a hook for DataPipe iterators in PyTorch, including snapshot state management, iterator validation, and profiling hooks.

classes.name: IteratorDecorator
classes.description: Wraps an iterator to add profiling, validity checks, and sample counting.

methods.name: _simplify_obj_name
methods.description: Simplifies object display strings for error messages.

methods.name: _strip_datapipe_from_name
methods.description: Removes 'IterDataPipe' and 'MapDataPipe' from class name strings.

methods.name: _generate_input_args_string
methods.description: Generates a string of input arguments for an object based on its signature.

methods.name: _generate_iterdatapipe_msg
methods.description: Creates a descriptive message for a DataPipe instance.

methods.name: _gen_invalid_iterdatapipe_msg
methods.description: Returns an error message indicating an invalidated iterator.

methods.name: _check_iterator_valid
methods.description: Checks if an iterator ID is valid for a DataPipe, raises error if invalid.

methods.name: _set_datapipe_valid_iterator_id
methods.description: Updates the valid iterator ID for a DataPipe and resets it.
